item.title: 'The Hunger Games: Sunrise On The Reaping' Overcomes 'Grand Theft Auto VI's' Billions For $120 Million At The Box Office
item.description: Lionsgate's incredible year continues. After "Michael" took in $372 million at the domestic box office this past spring, a franchise favorite has given the mini-major its biggest opening in over a decade. That stateside tally is over double the $44.6 million "The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes" earned three years ago.
